description: This file is a Markdown documentation page for the JSHandle class in a software project, likely part of the Playwright API documentation. It describes the class, its methods, parameters, and usage examples.

classes.name: JSHandle
classes.description: Represents an in-page JavaScript object handle that can be used to evaluate and interact with JavaScript objects within a page context.

methods.name: JSHandle.asElement
methods.description: Returns the object handle itself if it is an ElementHandle, or null otherwise.

methods.name: JSHandle.dispose
methods.description: Stops referencing the JavaScript object, disposing of the handle.

methods.name: JSHandle.evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates an expression in the context of the referenced object, returning the result.

methods.name: JSHandle.evaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates an expression and returns a JSHandle for the result.

methods.name: JSHandle.getProperties
methods.description: Returns a map of the object's own property names to JSHandle instances.

methods.name: JSHandle.getProperty
methods.description: Fetches a single property from the referenced object.

methods.name: JSHandle.jsonValue
methods.description: Returns a JSON-serializable representation of the object.
